==Biography==
=== 2020 Season ===
ry0ma joined [[100 Thieves]] for the [[LCS 2020 Spring Season]]. At the time, there was significant community backlash against North American teams importing players, specifically while NA mid laners [[Pobelter]] and [[Damonte]] didn't have starting spots on any LCS teams. However, 100 Thieves General Manager [[PapaSmithy]] released a statement saying that ry0ma had been chosen for having a high baseline of skill, strong references, and an exceptional performance in a tryout.<ref>[https://twitter.com/PapaSmithy/status/1199494189215412224 PapaSmithy's Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>

== Trivia ==
* Copied his friend's username because he liked the sound of it.
** Never watched the source anime to which his username is a reference.
